321549.title: The Hartke–Stolee–West–Yancey upper-bound conjecture for p-extremal excess
321549.record_statement:
Let $p$, $k$, and $t$ be integers such that $k\in\{1,\dots,2t\}$ and

$$
k(2t-1)!!\leq p < (k+1)(2t-1)!!.
$$

Set $C_p=t^2-t+k-1$. **Hartke–Stolee–West–Yancey conjecture.** For these parameters, the maximum excess $c_p$ of a graph with $p$ perfect matchings satisfies

$$
c_p\leq C_p.
$$

This gives an explicit upper bound for the excess and is intended to support the stated order estimate for $c_p$; the supplied text gives no resolution evidence.

321583.title: Runners-up conjecture for the Erdős–Littlewood–Offord bound
321583.record_statement: Let $\lambda$ range over integer partitions with exactly $k$ parts and greatest common divisor $1$, and let $r_\lambda$ be the associated Erdős–Littlewood–Offord probability. **Runners-up conjecture.** If $k\geq4$ is even, the second-largest value of $r_\lambda$ is attained uniquely by $2^2 1^{k-2}$. If $k\geq7$ is odd, the largest value is attained by $2\,1^{k-1}$, and the second-largest value is attained uniquely by $2^3 1^{k-3}$. The leading odd-length assertion is proved in the paper, whereas the uniqueness assertions for the runners-up are conjectural. The claim concerns the ordering of concentration probabilities that determines which null-vector templates contribute most strongly to singularity expansions.
321583.remaining: Restore concentration-at-zero versus maximum-atom convention and uniqueness modulo scaling; no partition search performed.

321278.title: The z-Parity Alexander polynomial span conjecture for virtual knots
321278.record_statement:
Let $K$ be a virtual knot. Let $n$ be the minimum number of real (non-virtual) crossings in any diagram of $K$, and let $z^{e_{max}}$ and $z^{e_{min}}$ be, respectively, the highest and lowest powers of $z$ appearing in the z-Parity Alexander Polynomial of $K$.

**z-Parity Alexander polynomial span conjecture.** The exponents satisfy

$$
e_{max}-e_{min}\leq n.
$$

The authors state that they verified this conjecture computationally for virtual knots with fewer than $6$ real crossings. Its general status is not established in the supplied text.
